title: "M12 - Standalone Module"

## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M12 - API Recommendation.

## Technical Scope

- RAG uses sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for top-10 retrieval over 72 catalog entries
- Best reported scenario: description plus RAG with 30/30 match rate and 75 percent hit rate
- Limited to Python library ecosystem in current evaluation
- Max context length in current setup: 4096 tokens
- Designed as PoC for iterative optimization

## Run Guidance

Use OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint with optional retrieved catalog context

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
